notes: Exalted: The Fair Folk supplied and reviewed cover to cover. 263 core-book rows reviewed and inventoried under docs/references/exalted1e/fair-folk/inventory/: the character-creation overview (split into separate common- and noble-raksha rows), the four base castes (Diplomat/Entertainer/Warrior/Worker), the twelve named noble hybrid castes, the five Graces (Cup/Ring/Staff/Sword/Heart) with their forging rules, the Bedlam mechanic (the raksha's Limit-Trait analog) including all four Virtue-specific Curses, the five new Backgrounds (Birth/Freehold/Gossamer/Retinue/Style), the altered Backgrounds (Artifact/Familiar/Manse/Backing-Contacts-Influence) and the excluded ones (Followers/Resources), the core signature mechanics (Wyld-damage immunity, Craft (Glamour), Wyld Stunts/Bonuses, Gossamer-and-Glamour, Mutation, Shaping Actions/Reality Shaping, Shaping Combat basics, Oaths, Cold-Wrought Iron), all of Chapter Five: Raksha Magic end to end (all five per-Grace Charm trees, the universal Assumption-type Charm tree, the Vexing/Questing rules, Glamour Sorcery/Wyld Artifacts/Adjurations/Behemoths, and the narrowly-scoped sixth shinma Nirupadhika), and a triage pass across the remaining Chapters One/Two/Six/Seven that found and added the two remaining genuinely player-facing items (the Gossamer Manta vehicle and the post-creation Experience and Training Time table) and definitively confirmed, via an exhaustive book-wide text search, that Fair Folk has no dedicated Merits/Flaws section anywhere in the book. That universal gap is now filled by a second source book, the Exalted Players Guide's Chapter One, 'Merits and Flaws' -- 73 more rows (37 merits + 36 flaws, 336 total), derived from Lunar's already-verified transcription of that chapter's full 88 pg-merit-*/pg-flaw-* rows rather than an independent re-read, since the chapter is explicitly universal across all five planned families. 15 of the 88 were skipped as inapplicable to a raksha -- a being of pure Wyld/chaos that is not Exalted at all, with no Essence-reincarnation cycle, no anima or Caste Mark, no blood lineage, and no access to core Exalted Sorcery (e.g. the Dragon-Blooded-only Legendary Breeding, the Celestial-Exalted-only Known Anathema/Permanent Caste Mark/Greater Curse/Throwback, the Abyssals-and-Ghosts-only Death-Taint, the Lunars-only Chimera/Limited Forms, and the Exalted-only Sworn Brotherhood/Beacon of Power); several included rows were reinterpreted for the raksha's own framework (Large Size/Small reframed around Assumption-type shapeshifting Charms instead of Lunar forms, Cache/Debt reframed around the Gossamer Background instead of Resources, Vice/Callous cross-referenced to Bedlam instead of the Great Curse, and Mutation/Weak Essence flagged as unusually strong fits since raksha are Wyld-stuff given shape starting at Essence 2), each judgment call flagged verbatim in that row's own notes. **Exalted: The Fair Folk is now reviewed cover to cover, including the universal Merits/Flaws gap.** A later pass added two small sets of universal (non-splat-restricted) artifact catalog rows, bringing the total to 351: 6 rows derived from Lunar's already-verified transcription of the Exalted Storyteller's Companion's universal 'Further Wonders' artifact catalog (Ghost Cestus, Sling Bow of Ice, The Golden Viper, Land Ship, Singing Staff, Eye of Autochthon -- a fifth source book for this family), and 9 rows freshly transcribed from a sixth source book, Savage Seas, whose 'Artifacts of the Waves' section is likewise a universal naval-artifact catalog (Cargo Preservation Spindles, Armor of Aquatic Puissance, Steelsilk Sails, Storm Sapphire, Cord of Winds, Wavecleaver Daiklaive, Light Implosion Bow, Lightning Ballista, and a reference-only Artifact Ship Weapons summary table). The Light Implosion Bow's own text explicitly names Fair Folk as capable users; the Lightning Ballista carries one flagged judgment call over whether its 'unExalted' phrasing bars a raksha who nonetheless manipulates Essence. Nothing promoted to a production catalog yet. Chapter Six's Mountain Folk (a wholly separate playable-adjacent race with its own extensive character creation) was deliberately not inventoried here -- out of Fair Folk (raksha) scope. Locked pending schema/rules/creator/editor implementation and passing tests across all five planned families. A final cross-splat supplement-triage pass added 14 rows (351 -> 365) from Exalted: Blood and Salt: a Lintha-connection Character Backgrounds reinterpretation sidebar, a Bluehaven approach-navigation rule, four regional Character Concepts lists, seven new Artifacts (including the Talisman of the Cult of Dukantha, which grants Infernal sorcery access), one new Hearthstone (Jewel of Stability), three mundane equipment items; the rest of the book's NPC/monster stat-block material was reviewed and confirmed out of scope, and four reprinted artifacts (plus, where applicable, a reprinted Hearthstone and two reprinted/superseded spells) received citation notes on their existing rows rather than new duplicate rows.
